subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’. Rahul __shall write__ the exam at this time next week.
solution:
The correct answer is ' shall be writing.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence shoule be written in future continuous tense and in Active Voice.
 
• We use the **future continuous** to refer to temporary actions and **events that will be in progress at a particular time in the future.**
 
• Structure: Subject + will/shall + be + V1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__
 __
 
• *​Example: He will be playing football tonight. (Active Voice)*
 
 
 
• 'V1 + ing' form of 'write' is 'writing'.
 
• Therefore, the use of 'shall write' should be replaced with 'shall be writing' to make it grammatically correct.

 

Correct sentence__: *Rahul **__shall be writing__** the exam at this time next week.*
